question: In which state of India is the Natyanjali festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tamil Nadu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **annual dance celebratio**n called Natyanjali Festival honours the **Hindu god Shiva.**
 
• It began in the y**ear 1981** and was first a somewhat **unnoticed event.**
 
• Now, the** Natyanjali Trust and the Tamil Nadu Tourism Department** are working together to organize it.
 
• The dancing festival celebrated at the **Sri Sabanayagar Temple in Chidambaram **has a connection to Natyanjali.
 
• A Bharatanatyam composition called **Natyanjali** was created in** 1968 by V. P. Dhananjayan.**
 
• **Mamallapuram Dance Festival** is another dance festival famous in Tamil Nadu.
